_note: 1.31.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_restore_places.md, 2026-09-30): places where resting (Vitals.Resting "rest") for the whole elapsed time recovers faster. Stamina: the multiplier scales rest (+20 an hour); mana: it scales passive regeneration (Settings > Body and magic). Rules are checked in order for every five minutes of the rest and the first that fits sets the multiplier; none fits = usual. if: dark (outside daylight, as Practice daylight), from/to (minutes of the day), days, weeks ([month, week]), sky (weather sky), snow, tempMin/tempMax (degrees C outside), arrivedCold (Chilled or Soaked before the rest). With the weather off, weather conditions never fit. clears: a condition ended after that many minutes of rest there. Read by gen_engine.py (engine) and gen_ui.py (map card).

founders_statue_and_park.summary: Stamina x1.5 while resting in fair daylight; x1.75 on a warm sunny afternoon; nothing extra in rain, snow, fog, cold or after dark

rules.why: too cold to lie on the grass

medical_centre.summary: Stamina x1.75 while resting in the ward; x1.25 in exam weeks, competition weeks and the week after the Thinning

rules.why: a busy week: the beds go to the injured first

bathhouse_and_washrooms.summary: Stamina x2 while resting in your own dorm's bathhouse; x2.5 on a cold day or when you come in chilled or soaked; 30 minutes ends Chilled

cathedral.summary: Mana x1.25 while sitting quietly on the pews; x1.75 during the Sunday service (09:00-11:00)

meditation_rooms.summary: Mana x2 while resting; x2.5 in the quiet morning (07:00-09:00); x1.75 in exam weeks, when every room is full

rules.why: exam week: every room is full

forest_clearing.summary: Mana x3 while resting among the Elder Oak's roots; x3.5 in full sun; x2 after dark
